mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, measured by quarter-over-quarter percent change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ growth accelerates.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production, measured by the INDPRO index falling more than 1% month-over-month, signals a weakening supply environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 55% of instances where INDPRO declines > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment, measured by the UNRATE increasing more than 0.3 percentage points over 3 months, signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of rising CPI inflation and falling federal funds rates signals a monetary policy mismatch that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 3 months AND FEDFUNDS falls > 0.25pp in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS move in opposite directions by the specified amounts.

mechanism_narrative: Falling housing starts, measured by the HOUST index declining more than 5% year-over-year, signals a weakening housing market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines > 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of rising unemployment and falling payroll employment signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 2 months AND PAYEMS falls > 100k in 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE and PAYEMS move in the specified adverse directions.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rates, measured by FEDFUNDS increasing more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months, signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of accelerating GDP growth and rising retail sales signals a strengthening consumer demand environment that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth accelerates AND RSAFS YoY growth > 5%
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 and RSAFS move in the specified favorable directions.
